## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (59%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Input reliability is flagged [F6], and the 90% conformal set cannot separate Benign from InSitu [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 59%, InSitu 37%, Normal 3%, Invasive 1% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Split between Benign and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, flagged (AUROC 70%, n=1716) | Out-of-distribution input; suspect read |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (models disagree on top class) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (60%), 1 InSitu, 1 Invasive (82%–84% similarity) [F5] | Weak consensus among nearest neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.20, contribution -0.71) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 4, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.27, contribution -0.46) favors duct-confined lesion [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 2) · context · Below-typical score (+0.17, contribution +0.36); descriptive context only [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 4, 9) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+1.25, contribution +0.18), failed AI spot-check (3/20) · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Text-only score (+0.96, contribution -0.16), caption-inconsistent, favors non-invasive · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on 132 test cases; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20), and normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Out-of-distribution frozen-section artifacts (100th percentile) distort features; foundation models disagree, and margin calls are deferred [F7].
- InSitu (37% probability) or focal invasion in region 1 (74% risk; 83% similar to invasive BACH_0138) is under-sampled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 1** (74% tile risk): Inspect for stromal invasion; ignore its Unreliable mitoses score (0/20 AI spot-check).
2. **Regions 0, 4, 9**: Evaluate ductal atypia to distinguish Benign from InSitu (37%); ignore Unreliable necrosis scores.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Review medial, superior, and inferior margins; consider drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
